name: TIM
verdict: Owned by the Italian state through Poste Italiane, which holds 66.6% of TIM. Nothing found.
note: Main Partner of the Ducati Lenovo Team: on Ducati's partner page its logo, which links to tim.it, stands under 'Main Partners' with the line 'Telecommunications operator' (Wayback Machine captures of 23 May and 18 Sep 2026). Rating note (2026-09-30): Poste Italiane holds 66.627% of TIM's ordinary shares and is the only holder above 3% (TIM, 24 Sep 2026); Poste Italiane is about 65% held by Italy's Ministry of the Economy and Finance and Cassa Depositi e Prestiti (tim-poste-ownership). State ownership alone is not a tier, and this data has no record of serious abuses for Italy. No human-rights finding against the company by a court, regulator, UN body or major NGO was found.
